metadata.name: hold_launchpad
metadata.description: Bonding curve launchpad with pool-level sell rate limit

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Step 2: the proposed admin signs to accept, which proves the address is real and usable.

instructions.name: claim_platform_fees
docs: Anyone can trigger this. The money can only go to the treasury address in the config.

instructions.name: claim_pool_fees
docs: Anyone can call this. Collects the trading fees the locked pool has earned (always in SOL) and sends them to the
treasury address in the config. Nothing else can receive them.

instructions.name: claim_rewards
docs: Pay out the holder rewards this wallet has earned from other people's sell taxes.

instructions.name: create_curve
docs: Create a token + curve. The full supply is minted into the curve vault and the
mint authority is revoked in the same instruction.
- `fee_bps` / `holder_fee_bps`: trade fee on every buy and sell, paid to the creator and to holders. Their sum is the fee charged (max 5%).
- `max_tax_bps` / `decay_secs`: sell tax that starts at max and fades to 0 over `decay_secs` of holding.
The tax stays in the curve, so it lifts the price for everyone still holding.
- `reward_bps`: share of every sell tax paid out to holders (pro-rata by curve-bought balance). The rest stays in the curve.
- `holder_sell_bps` / `window_secs`: one wallet can sell at most this share of its own balance per window.

instructions.name: graduate_create_pool
docs: Graduation step 2 (anyone can call): create the Meteora pool from the funds set aside, opening at the price those
funds imply. The caller supplies the price and liquidity numbers; the program checks them against the real funds.

accounts.name: wsol_mint
docs: pinned to the wrapped SOL mint

instructions.name: graduate_lock
docs: Graduation step 3 (anyone can call): lock the pool's liquidity for good. After this nobody can ever withdraw it.

instructions.name: graduate_prepare
docs: Graduation step 1 (anyone can call once a token is full): switch the transfer hook off for good, then move the
leftover tokens and the SOL raised (minus a small fixed setup cost) to the token's graduation address.

accounts.name: mint
docs: writable: switching off the transfer hook changes the mint

instructions.name: init_config
docs: One-time setup, only by the program's upgrade authority. The admin starts as that authority and can hand over to a multisig.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Step 1 of handing admin to someone else (for example a multisig).

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Emergency stop for NEW BUYS and NEW TOKENS only. Selling and claiming rewards always keep working.

instructions.name: set_platform_fee
docs: Platform fee for tokens launched from now on. Existing tokens keep the fee they launched with.

errors.name: MathError
errors.msg: Math error or amount too small

errors.name: HolderLimitExceeded
errors.msg: This wallet already sold its share for this window

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Trading is paused: no new buys or new tokens right now. Selling still works.

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: You are not the proposed admin

errors.name: NotComplete
errors.msg: This token is not full yet, so it cannot graduate

errors.name: WrongStage
errors.msg: Graduation is not at the right step for this

errors.name: BadPrice
errors.msg: The opening price does not match the funds in the pool

errors.name: PoolNotFilled
errors.msg: The pool did not take all the funds, so it was cancelled

errors.name: AlreadyGraduating
errors.msg: This token is graduating: trading on the curve is over

fields.name: admin
docs: can pause, change the fee for new tokens, and hand over admin. Meant to be a multisig.

fields.name: treasury
docs: where claim_platform_fees sends the money

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: platform fee given to tokens launched from now on

fields.name: paused
docs: true = no new buys and no new tokens. Sells and reward claims are never blocked.

fields.name: accrued_platform_fees
docs: platform fees waiting to be sent to the treasury

fields.name: holder_fee_bps
docs: extra trade fee, paid to holders instead of the creator

fields.name: platform_fee_bps
docs: platform fee locked in when this token launched

fields.name: reward_bps
docs: share of each sell tax paid to holders

fields.name: total_tracked
docs: sum of every position's curve-bought balance

fields.name: acc_per_token
docs: cumulative lamports of reward per token unit, scaled by ACC_SCALE

fields.name: reward_pool
docs: lamports owed to holders and not yet claimed (held in the curve account, outside the price reserves)

fields.name: graduated_stage
docs: graduation progress: 0 not started, 1 funds moved and hook off, 2 pool created, 3 liquidity locked (done)

fields.name: lp_sol
docs: SOL and tokens set aside for the pool at stage 1

fields.name: pool
docs: the Meteora pool, its position token, and the liquidity put in (set at stage 2)

types.name: Position
docs: Per-wallet, per-token bookkeeping: hold clock + sell window.

fields.name: avg_ts
docs: balance-weighted average buy time of tokens bought through the curve (0 = none yet)

fields.name: tracked
docs: tokens bought through the curve and still held (transfers in don't count)

fields.name: window_base
docs: wallet balance when the current sell window opened

fields.name: window_sold
docs: tokens sold in the current window

fields.name: reward_debt
docs: tracked * acc_per_token / ACC_SCALE at the last change; earnings are measured from here

fields.name: pending_rewards
docs: banked rewards not yet claimed

fields.name: rewards
docs: part of the tax paid out to holders

fields.name: fee_to_holders
docs: part of the trade fee paid out to holders

fields.name: fee_to_platform
docs: part of the trade fee that goes to the platform
